pages.text: A little wooden stage stood in the square. Today was the village singing day.
Soso loved singing best. Beside the stage, Soso quietly sang along.
The five stood in a row on the stage. People sat in front of them.
The song began. Soso opened their mouth.
But no sound came out. Their mouth only opened and closed.
The four sang to the end. Soso couldn't sing a single word.
They came off the stage. Soso bowed their head low.
Grandma Bear held Soso's hand. "With a voice beside you, yours can follow."
The four put Soso in the middle. Together, they sang the first line.
Sound came from Soso's mouth. Their voice reached the far end of the square.
